response: Ganglionated plexi (GP) ablation during the Maze IV procedure is not beneficial for achieving postoperative long-term stable sinus rhythm. According to the available data, GP ablation did not prove to be beneficial for postoperative stable normal sinus rhythm (NSR). Instead, a complete left atrial lesion set and biatrial ablation are advisable for improving rhythm outcomes. Randomized controlled trials are necessary to confirm these findings and provide more definitive guidance on the effectiveness of GP ablation in this context.
